reason: The cited lines open SQLite database files from resolved paths (including paths derived from a workspacePath or an environment-configured examples directory) in read-only mode and return queryDatabase results, so they show host/database contents being read into the tool result. Because those databases can be selected from workspace/runtime locations and their contents can be user/workspace-controlled, the returned data can be untrusted. The lines do not show arbitrary host command/code execution, and they do not show sending data to an attacker-readable external destination or other sink.
